id: title:DanielVisca:add source column to logs metric rule migration

observations.behavior: Adds a new database column `source` with choices distinguishing logs versus spans, establishing record type at ingestion time.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows LogsMetricRule to support both traditional log records and distributed span records without shared state conflicts.

observations.behavior: Updates the unique constraint from (team, metric_name) to include the newly added source field as part of uniqueness enforcement.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents duplicate rules across different sources while maintaining compatibility for existing log-only configurations via the migration's removal and re-addition of this constraint.

observations.behavior: Replaces docstring text specifying only 'ingested logs' with broader scope including 'spans', alongside addition of RecordSource enum and span-specific group-by keys.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that the rule engine now supports two distinct data consumers, not just one, aligning documentation with model changes.
